before: A document opened behind a painted frame stayed behind the loading screen until every page was laid out, and its last layout ran in one task.
after: The open ends on the first pages and lays the rest out in short tasks (snapshot().isPaginating, the paginated event); the fit is settled before the first layout; openAfterPaint: 'every' opens any document this way. The finished pages are the same.
reason: Only when a local layout runs and what the local view paints meanwhile change. Nothing enters shared state, operations, snapshots sent to peers, or protocol messages, and the document model is untouched.
